turns.response_markdown:
Total workload: **8 hours**  
Maximum capacity: **3 hours/day**  
Minimum required duration: **3 days** (9 available hours)

| Day | Tasks | Time | Dependencies |
|---|---|---:|---|
| **Day 1** | Research | 2 hrs | None — gather sources, notes, background material |
|  | Outline | 1 hr | Requires completion of research (or enough initial research to define structure) |
| **Day 2** | Writing (Part 1) | 3 hrs | Requires outline completed |
| **Day 3** | Writing (Part 2) | 0 hrs* | Continues from Day 2 draft if needed |
|  | Review and revision | 2 hrs | Requires draft completion |
|  | Final polish / formatting | 1 hr | Requires review feedback applied |

\*The writing allocation is **3 hours total**, so it can be completed entirely on Day 2. If the draft needs more working space, shift 1 hour of Day 3 review time into writing.

### Dependency chain
**Research → Outline → Writing → Review → Final polish**

### Alternative balanced schedule (uses all 3 days evenly)

| Day | Tasks | Time |
|---|---|---:|
| Day 1 | Research | 2 hrs |
|  | Outline | 1 hr |
| Day 2 | Writing | 3 hrs |
| Day 3 | Review | 2 hrs |
|  | Final formatting/check | 1 hr |

This version keeps each day at or below the 3-hour limit and preserves all task dependencies.
